title: Tensor counit square for derived open extension
statement: For a commutative ring A and a scheme S, let j be the standard affine chart in the projective line over S [def-amb-affine-trace-construction]. For every H,M in the unbounded etale derived category of the projective line [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the specified openAction [def-pur-ordinary-affine-tensor-actions] on j* M, followed by extension by zero of the inverse tensor pullback comparison [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows] and the actual counit at H tensor M, equals tensoring H with the actual counit at M. The ordinary pullback and canonical signed symmetries are fixed, not chosen

theorem derivedOpenCounit_tensorAction
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (S : Scheme.{u})
    (H M : DerivedCategoryModule A (ProjectiveLine S)) :
    OrdinaryAffineTensorActions.openAction A S H
        ((ordinaryFinitePullback A (ProjectiveLine.affineChart S)).obj M) ≫
      (affineTraceOpenLeft A S).map
        (ordinaryFiniteTensorPullback A (ProjectiveLine.affineChart S) H M).symm.hom ≫
      (affineTraceOpenAdjunction A S).counit.app
        (((ordinaryFiniteTensor A (ProjectiveLine S)).obj H).obj M) =
      ((ordinaryFiniteTensor A (ProjectiveLine S)).obj H).map
        ((affineTraceOpenAdjunction A S).counit.app M)
